spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, diciendo: Varón varón cuando fuere impuro a alma, o en camino lejos a ustedes, o a sus generaciones, y hará Pésaj a Jehová.

findings.issue: פסח is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper name locked in PROPER_NAMES; Pésaj leaves the non-name lemma untranslated.
כי is marked only as a conjunction; cuando selects the temporal sense and closes the open conditional reading.

notes: The 2mp suffix on לכם and דורותיכם is ustedes address; sus is that possessive, not a third-party shift.
